v4-24.display:
On their return they sang hymns and blessed Heaven:
“For it is good,
for His mercy is for ever.”

v4-30.display:
He saw the strong army and prayed, saying,
“Blessed art Thou, Saviour of Israel,
who didst crush the mighty man’s assault by the hand of Thy servant David,
and didst deliver the foreigners’ army into the hands of Jonathan son of Saul and his armour-bearer.

v4-31.display:
So shut this army into the hand of Thy people Israel,
and let them be ashamed of their force and their cavalry.

v4-33.display:
Bring them down by the sword of those who love Thee,
and let all who know Thy name praise Thee with hymns.”
